I'm sorry, I know that's not the answer you wanted. Under our policy, a box that has already been billed isn't refunded when you cancel, and it is still sent. Your cancellation on the 27th applies from the following month's box onward, so you won't be charged again. There's no cancellation fee.

Our policy doesn't offer an exception to this. If you'd like, I can escalate your case to a Support Lead to review. I can't promise a different outcome. Also, the plant in this box comes with the normal Plant Care Guarantee.
